Deepak Gulati decreased its stake in Express Scripts Hldg (ESRX) by 61.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Argent Trust Company sold 12,192 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.58% with the market. The hedge fund run by Deepak Gulati held 7,517 shares of the medical and nursing services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $561,000, down from 19,709 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Argent Trust Company who had been investing in Express Scripts Hldg for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $40.89 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.59% or $1.84 during the last trading session, reaching $72.8. About 5.79 million shares traded or 14.63% up from the average. Express Scripts Holding Company (NASDAQ:ESRX) has risen 8.93% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 2.62% the S&P500.
